以下是引擎調校迴圈此刻的狀態。決定**下一個該做什麼**：一個具體的動作，
不要複述狀態。已經被排除的路線不要再走一次。

QUESTION: Is the segment-boundary ordering the cause of the S1 divergence, i.e. does turning the segmented async dispatcher off make the S1 arm bit-identical?

EVIDENCE ON HAND:
- [eng-20260915-213258-p25-gputime-noasync-r1] p25-gputime-noasync (CGC_SERVER_OA_ASYNC=0) gives md5 {dc055e63}, misses 13040, file_reads 36360 -- identical to the segmented anchor p25-gputime on all three.
    build=same-as-above  quotable=True
- [eng-20260915-213356-p25-slotgpu-noasync-r1] p25-slotgpu-noasync (CGC_SERVER_OA_ASYNC=0) gives md5 {29ca694a, 672585db, b8c705cc}, misses 14296, file_reads 39948 -- identical to the segmented S1 arm p25-slotgpu on all three. Two arms that are supposed to be switching a dispatcher produced the exact same digest SET and the exact same pool counters.
    build=same-as-above  quotable=False
- [artifact src/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-backend.cpp] Line 1745 gated the segmented dispatch on `getenv("CGC_OA_ASYNC") != nullptr && getenv("CGC_VERIFY_OP_TIMING") == nullptr && strcmp(ggml_backend_name(split_backend), "CPU") != 0`. A != nullptr test selects on PRESENCE, not value, so CGC_OA_ASYNC=0 -- and an empty string, since getenv returns "" and not NULL -- took the segmented branch. scripts/run_server.sh sets CGC_OA_ASYNC unconditionally from SERVER_OA_ASYNC, so there was no way to unset it through the runner either.

ALREADY RULED OUT (do not re-walk these):
- claim: CGC_SERVER_OA_ASYNC=0 selects the non-segmented dispatcher, so the earlier noasync pair isolates the ordering effect.
  why false: ggml-backend.cpp:1745 tested getenv("CGC_OA_ASYNC") != nullptr. The value is never read, so 0 selected the segmented branch exactly as 1 does, and the two arms reproduced the segmented arms' md5 sets and pool counters verbatim.

Re-run the pair against the rebuilt binary and compare within the pair only: p25-slotgpu-noasync bit-identical to p25-gputime-noasync means the ordering was the cause and the fix is to keep the segment drain tied to the hook rather than to the leaf; still different means the ordering is not it and the remaining suspect is the allocator layout (GGML_SCHED_DEBUG=2). Both arms must carry the same value of this switch or the comparison is meaningless -- the same class of mistake as A5's length rule, with a build switch instead of a generation length.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
第 i 層的 `wait` 是「到第 i 層為止累積的 GPU 工作量減掉 CPU 進度」，所以 L0 幾乎不用等。實測：285 t/s 的快跑裡最低的一層也是 L0（112 ms 對 155 ms 平台）；122 t/s 的慢跑逐層 wait 是 124,171,199,230,336,629,606,503,433,272,...——爬升到 L5 峰值後進入 342-404 ms 平台，`peak/mean=1.75` 但 `IQR/median=0.094`。用 `max/mean>1.5` 的門檻會判成 LOCALISED，而那是結構性暫態，與快慢狀態無關。

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
報告 §3.2 的第一次自動判定把慢跑印成 `LOCALISED in one layer (=> implementation)`，與同一份資料的 2.32× / CV 6.5% 逐層比值結論相反。

它管轄的檔案：`scripts/check/prefill_certifiability.py`, `scripts/check/prefill_gputime_report.py`, `docs/PREFILL250_THERMAL_TRANSIENT_20260916.html`
判「逐層是均勻變慢還是局部變慢」時，用**中位數 + IQR/中位數 + 落在中位數 ±25% 內的層比例**，不要用 `max/mean`。管線化的逐段迴圈（`submit_ahead`）在前幾層天生等得少，那個爬升段會支配 `max/mean`，把均勻的圖判成局部。

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
index_assets.py --check printed 'manifest OK: 56 assets, 0 drift' while MANIFEST.jsonl still carried scripts/check/decode_sweep.py at 33992 bytes / mtime 20:52:01 although the file on disk was 38127 bytes / 21:07:40. It only asked os.path.exists per recorded path, so editing any indexed file was invisible. Comparing bytes+mtime surfaced 18 real drifts at once -- but 3 of them were Backup/phase_decomp, Backup/cgc_logs and .workbuddy/memory/2026-09-15.md, i.e. the loop's OWN outputs, which change on every run by design; shipping only that half would have left the check permanently red and therefore trained the reader to ignore it. The fix needed both halves: compare bytes+mtime for source assets, and mark run outputs volatile (existence-only). Verified red-then-green: 18 drifts -> classify -> 12 drifts (the 6 genuine edits stay) -> regenerate -> 0 drifts.

它管轄的檔案：`agent_harness/engine_loop/index_assets.py`, `agent_harness/engine_loop/MANIFEST.jsonl`

A drift check must test the property whose change it claims to detect, and must separate what is ALLOWED to change from what is not. A check that only tests existence and a check that reddens on every run are both ignored -- the second failure mode is the mirror of the first, and both are cured only by classifying the subject.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
After the layer-0 zero-region work closed (the probe was 4096 B wide against a 4592-13120 B zero prefix, i.e. a probe-width bug in the triage tools), the summary said '250/25 has nothing blocking it now'. Three errors: (1) that work was never on the 250/25 path at all -- the road was equally 'clear' before it started, and 250/25 was still not done; (2) the road's declared #1 dependency M1/W3 is not unimplemented but 'implemented, measured, and rejected' (docs/M1_POOL_SPLIT_COST_2026-09-14.md), with two blockers each carrying an exact failure signature -- and its Blocker B lives in the very bookkeeping (slot_owner / slot_table / batch_owned) that the zero-region work had just been reading, so the session's work was ADJACENT to the obstacle, not past it; and (3) prefill250 and prod25 are different configs competing for the same 16 GB (ctx 8192 + ubatch 6144 vs ctx 4096 + model-default batch, shared 8 GiB pool), which was not mentioned at all.

它管轄的檔案：`docs/M1_POOL_SPLIT_COST_2026-09-14.md`, `docs/ROADMAP_PREFILL250_DECODE25_2026-09-13.md`, `docs/PREFILL250_CERTIFIABILITY_20260916.html`

Closing a defect in a MEASUREMENT INSTRUMENT is not the same as clearing an obstacle on a PERFORMANCE path, and must never be reported as 'the road is now clear'. An instrument defect being real does not make it load-bearing.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
Two halves, both measured on 2026-09-15. (1) The bisect at --n-predict 24 reported p25-gputime md5 dc055e63 while two runs 25 minutes earlier at --n-predict 40 both reported 3d8fa55f, and the llama binary had been rebuilt in between -- which made 'the new diagnostic probes changed the model output' the obvious reading and would have sent me off to bisect the probe code. decode_bench.py hashes the whole completion and stores predicted_n beside it as n_tokens_sample, so that difference is pure truncation. (2) The sharper half: rung 2 ran every arm at the SAME --n-predict 24 and the actual generated lengths still came out 24/24/12/22/7/6, so on the five rows whose digest differs from the anchor the difference is confounded twice over -- it cannot by itself separate 'the trajectory diverged' from 'the same prefix, stopped earlier'. What does separate them is sample = texts[0][:160]: the anchor begins with a <think> reasoning preamble and every affected arm differs from its very first character, which is a length-free claim. Comparing digests is a claim about equality, so the generated length is part of the claim.

它管轄的檔案：`scripts/check/decode_bench.py`, `scripts/check/decode_sweep.py`

Two generation digests are comparable only at the same ACTUAL generated length (predicted_n), not at the same --n-predict budget. When two completions stop at different lengths their digest difference is confounded with length, and the length-independent evidence is the fixed-width text prefix.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
run_server.sh's CGC_LOOP_GUARD push sat inside the else-branch of the CGC_SOFT_POOL_L1 test (a missing `fi`), so setting CGC_SOFT_POOL_L1 -- exactly what the comment 6 lines above recommends ('opt back in with CGC_SOFT_POOL_L0=48 CGC_SOFT_POOL_L1=48') -- silently dropped CGC_LOOP_GUARD from the env handed to the server, and CGC_LOOP_GUARD=1 could not restore it because 'push the guard' lived in the branch that only runs when L1 is UNSET. Measured with CGC_DUMP_ENV=1 across four inputs: default -> pushed, L0=48 -> pushed, L1=48 -> DROPPED, L0=48 L1=48 -> DROPPED, plus L1=48 CGC_LOOP_GUARD=1 -> still DROPPED (the earlier 'L0+L1 keeps it' reading was a zsh quoting artifact of my own probe, not a property of the script). No default profile sets L1, so reading the default would never have exposed it. The fingerprint then carried the argument: the normalised dump md5 for prefill250 stabilised at e68a5dc537d626622a9af6c9c7ddf665 once the two volatile line classes were removed, and was IDENTICAL before and after the fix -- which justifies 'this change cannot move the gate numbers' without re-running the gate to find out. Raw (un-normalised) md5 is not stable: prefill250 differed on consecutive runs (8726fb39 vs f898bc94) while prod25 happened to match itself, i.e. a naive fingerprint is wrong in both directions.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
The dump's own volatility: `CGCENV LOG .../llama_server_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.log` carries a timestamp, and the `[preflight] free=NN%` / `[guard] ... free=NN%` lines track memory pressure. Without filtering both classes, 'stable' and 'changed' are both unreliable verdicts -- and unfiltered, two profiles in the SAME run set disagreed about which one was stable.

它管轄的檔案：`scripts/run_server.sh`, `agent_harness/CONVENTIONS.md`, `docs/PRECOMMIT_HOOK_GUIDE_20260916.html`

A launch configuration must be read by DUMPING it under the configuration you care about, not inferred from the default. Capture the resolved env as a normalised fingerprint so that 'the launch environment did not change' becomes a checkable claim -- and normalise correctly, or the instrument reports noise as change.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
`scripts/check_build_tracked.sh` 預設檢查 `build/bin`，但本 repo 的 build 產物在 `src/llama.cpp/build/bin`；於是它在這個 checkout 上會把追蹤/rpath/deadlock/binary-sync/replay 等區段**全部跳過**，最後仍印 `OK: build/bin 追蹤與 rpath 正常、main⊆dev 成立、……通過/未啟用。`——「未啟用」被折進同一句 OK 裡。實測：`RUN_REPLAY_BENCH=0 bash scripts/check_build_tracked.sh` 有 5 個區段跳過、卻以 OK 結束，我因此一度以為 檢查 8（原始碼↔binary 同步）已被驗證。

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
同一支 script 的輸出裡，`--- 檢查 dylib 被追蹤（洞 B） ---` 之後緊接 `SKIP build/bin 不存在 → 跳過 build/bin 追蹤 / rpath / deadlock / binary sync 檢查`，而最後一行仍是 `OK: ...`。修法是把 11 個跳過點改走 `skip()`（計數），摘要改為「沒有 FAIL，但有 N 個區段被 SKIP」。

它管轄的檔案：`scripts/check_build_tracked.sh`, `agent_harness/CONVENTIONS.md`
閘門的收尾摘要必須把「跑了但通過」與「根本沒跑」分開報。如果所有區段都跳過、摘要卻仍印一句無條件的 `OK`，那讀者（包括未來的自己）會把它讀成「全部驗證過」。每個跳過點都要計數，摘要要報出數目與理由。

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
Two independent instances in one round. (1) The slot-table churn instrument prints per-graph lines only for the first 10 graphs (graphs 0-9 were all `SEL-DRIFT entries=0`), and the earlier 'timing/race is refuted' conclusion was read off those lines -- while the same run's whole-run counter says `consumed_changed=192`, i.e. the consumed subset moved 192 times, necessarily after graph 9. (2) The slot-table clamp warning carries an explicit cap (`cgc_clamp_lines++ < 16`) and prints 16 identical lines, which reads like '16 layers are affected' when it is 'the print stopped at 16'. Both were in the same log as the measurement that used them.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
Run 2026-09-17 10:29 (p25-slotgpu-churn, CGC_S1_TABLE_CHURN=1): 10 graph-level `TABLE-CHURN` lines, all with `SEL-DRIFT ... entries=0`, and the aggregate line `S1 slot-table: publishes=1599 clamped_selected=0 clamped_table=180687 changed_entries=572 consumed_changed=192 consumed_unchanged_publishes=198`. The per-`il` clamp warning printed exactly 16 lines for il=1..16 on every layer that was checked.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/src/llama-context.cpp`

A diagnostic whose PRINT is capped is not a whole-run reading: the cap silently turns 'the first N instances' into 'the answer', and a negative conclusion drawn from it is a conclusion about the cap, not about the run. When an instrument prints both per-instance lines and an aggregate counter, the aggregate is the reading and the per-instance lines are samples -- so a zero in the samples can coexist with a non-zero total, and the total is what a claim must quote. Check the print cap before quoting a zero.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
`validate.py` 在 episode 規則下方寫了 `duplicates episode_id` 檢查，於是 decision 與 lesson 的 id 唯一性**完全沒有強制**。實際後果：`lessons.jsonl` 出現兩筆 `eng-gate-0006`（一筆是既有的 presence-vs-value 閘門教訓、一筆是本輪新寫的閘門摘要教訓）與兩筆 `eng-bound-0001`，而 validator 一路綠燈、連續數個 commit 都沒發現。id 是**鍵**：重複會讓 `supersedes`／`superseded_by` 的解析失去意義（指向哪一筆？），也讓「關於 X 的那條教訓」變成歧義——正是 D4 要防的失效模式。修法是把檢查泛化成 `(type, id_key)` 表，並用 `--dir` 對 HEAD 已提交的 `lessons.jsonl` 驗一次：立即報 `ERROR duplicate lesson_id eng-bound-0001`。

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
`python3 traces/validate.py <(git show HEAD:.../lessons.jsonl)` 在加入檢查後報 `ERROR duplicate lesson_id eng-bound-0001`，而加入檢查前同一份檔案報 `-> OK`。selftest 也從 8/8 變成 10/10（新增 `duplicate_lesson_id`、`duplicate_decision_id` 兩個多記錄案例）。

它管轄的檔案：`agent_harness/engine_loop/traces/validate.py`, `agent_harness/engine_loop/traces/selftest.py`, `agent_harness/CONVENTIONS.md`
完整性規則若只對「一種記錄型別」實作，就不要假設它對其他型別也成立——它通常只是被寫在那一型的規則旁邊，從未被泛化。id 唯一性就是例子：它有檢查，但只檢查 `episode_id`。

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
eng-diag-0017 established the weaker half of this (constructing a tensor is not putting it in the graph -- only ggml_build_forward_expand does). CGC_S1_BUILD_LEAF=1 exercised the other half and found that being in the graph is also not enough. The arm builds the host remap leaf and deliberately leaves it unconsumed, which is exactly what the header comment on cache_slot_table_tensors has always claimed S1 does ('the leaf itself is still built when this is on: it is simply not consumed ... a pure scheduler/dispatch change'). With `slots` neither consumed nor expanded, the GET_ROWS/CONT/VIEW chain drops out of the graph, `slot_table` is left alive only by the unconditional `ggml_build_forward_expand(gf, slot_table)` above it, and the new `remap` leaf is expanded too -- so the graph ends up with two roots that nothing reads. The server aborted in llama_context::graph_reserve, i.e. during context construction, having generated nothing. The practical form: 'build the node' is a sentence about the builder's intent; 'the node exists' requires a consumer, and a design that only satisfies the first cannot be measured at all -- so it must not be planned as the control for a hypothesis.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/src/llama-graph.cpp`, `src/llama.cpp/src/llama-context.h`

A graph node needs a CONSUMER, not just a traversal path: a tensor that is reached as a root with nothing consuming it is never assigned a backend, and ggml-alloc aborts on it (`ggml-alloc.c:623 GGML_ASSERT(buffer_id >= 0)`) before the first token.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
本輪為斷言 `ensure_batch` 的兩趟指派，在 `llama_expert_cache` 新增 `n_hit_adopted_queued`（8 bytes），把 `ever_loaded` 的偏移從 0x608 推到 0x610。A/B 用 `git stash` 換回 HEAD 建了舊 dylib（mtime 09:24:35），`stash pop`（09:27:22）之後**沒有重建**，於是「照新標頭編的測試」連上「照舊佈局編的庫」。執行結果是 `SIGSEGV / KERN_INVALID_ADDRESS at 0x0`，崩在 `libllama` 的 `llama_expert_cache_ensure_batch +1068`。把該指令反組譯回去（`ldr x9, [x10, x9]`，x10 來自 `[x8, #0x608]`）再對照 `offsetof` 印出的兩套偏移：0x608 在新佈局是 `n_slot_table_unchanged`（size_t，值 0，當成 data pointer 用 ⇒ 空指標索引），在舊佈局才是 `ever_loaded._M_start`。診斷靠四步在一分鐘內收斂：(a) `nm -gU` 確認符號有 exported；(b) `offsetof` 探針印出兩套偏移；(c) `strings` 顯示該 dylib **完全不含**新增的 `CGC-BATCH-INVARIANT` 字串 ⇒ 它是舊碼；(d) `stat` 兩個 mtime 一眼看完（庫 09:24 < 源碼 09:27）。

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
錯的處置是「測試寫錯了」——我的第一反應是回頭審測試的 `key_segs`/`slot_owner`/`ever_loaded` 初始化，那條路會一路改到看不出問題，因為測試本身沒有錯，錯的是它連到的庫。判準要換成「庫和標頭是不是同一棵樹」。留給下輪的產物：測試檔頭現在寫入完整編譯指令與這段 ABI 警告，並註明「動到這個標頭就要重建庫，再從同一棵樹重建測試」。

它管轄的檔案：`scripts/check/expert_cache_ensure_batch_order.cpp`, `src/llama.cpp/src/llama-expert-cache.h`, `agent_harness/CONVENTIONS.md`

在同一個 dylib 兩側以指標傳遞的 struct，新增一個成員就是一次連結器看不見的 ABI 破壞：它不會報錯，只會讓舊 dylib 讀到錯的成員偏移，症狀是「崩在函式庫裡」而不是連結失敗。所以任何用 `git stash` 換臂的 A/B，都會讓 build tree 停在被 stash 的那一臂——pop 之後的第一件事是**重建**，不是跑測試；與該標頭連結的測試／工具必須和它所連的樹同狀態重建。

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
The ffn_moe_down output capture was first written with `static int cgc_s1_out_n = 0; if (cgc_s1_out_n < 6)` around a loop that dumps every captured layer. graph_compute is called for every graph, so that budget is consumed by the first six graph computes of the process -- warmup and prefill chunk processing -- before the first decoded token exists. Prefill takes a different branch of the expert-cache hook entirely (it builds no remap leaf; the hook itself checks n_tokens), so the arms would have been compared at a graph where the S1 mechanism under test is not engaged, and the comparison would have reported 'identical' for a reason that has nothing to do with the mechanism. The fix is one line of predicate: the second parameter of graph_compute is `batched` (= ubatch.n_tokens > 1), so `if (cgc_s1_outcap && !batched)` both spends the budget on decode graphs and makes the printed ordinal an honest address within the phase being discussed.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
A 6-graph readback budget spent entirely on warmup and prefill, in a probe whose stated purpose was to compare one decode graph between two arms.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/src/llama-context.cpp`, `agent_harness/CONVENTIONS.md`

A capped diagnostic readback must be gated on the PHASE that contains the question, not merely on the knob that arms it. A driver's closing step must be able to fail the driver. A `python3 - <<'PY'` heredoc inside a bash script inherits no `set -e`, so a traceback in the final analysis step leaves the run's exit status at 0 and the run reads as complete -- and the step that gets skipped is exactly the one the next reader reaches for. Check the status of every heredoc/analysis step explicitly, and treat a traceback printed between two normal lines as a silent failure rather than as noise. Related and easy to miss: a path join written `p / "a" + name` parses as `(p / "a") + name`, so a Path-plus-string TypeError hides inside a line that looks like a path join.

觀測（because）：
A GGUF header parser reproduced the loader's pool-capacity formula as `per_slot = MAX over all layers`. The loader computes that MAX over TRUNK layers only (it skips the NextN/MTP layer explicitly, so the trunk's pool cannot depend on how the head happens to be stored) while still counting every layer in the denominator. On the shipped model the two agree, because its MTP layer is THINNER than the trunk's binding layer -- so the tool matched the engine on every check that had been run (107/143/179 verified against two engine runs). The moment a second model was tried whose MTP layer is q8_0 and thus thicker, the tool reported 15 slots where the engine computes 148. When a tool reimplements an engine's formula, validate it on at least two artifacts that differ in exactly the dimension the formula's conditionals touch -- and make the tool print which branch it took. Concretely: any reimplementation must read the SAME discriminators the engine reads (here, the GGUF's own nextn count), not infer them from the artifact in hand, because the artifact in hand may happen to make the branch irrelevant.
